shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- package ---\\n' && cat package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/esm/utils 2>/dev/null | head; rg \"useTheme\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -20; sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/esm/ThemeProvider/ThemeProvider.d.ts 2>/dev/null"

/bin/bash -lc "perl -0pi -e \"s/import \\{ ThemeProvider \\} from '\\@gravity-ui\\/uikit';/import { ThemeManager } from '.\\/ThemeManager';/; s/    <ThemeProvider theme=\\\"light\\\">/    <ThemeManager>/; s/    <\\/ThemeProvider>/    <\\/ThemeManager>/\" src/main.tsx
perl -0pi -e 's|\\{/\\* TODO: implement the requested component \\*/\\}|Переключите тему, чтобы сохранить выбор.|' src/App.tsx
cat src/main.tsx
printf '\\n--- App ---\\n'
cat src/App.tsx
printf '\\n--- status ---\\n'
git status --short
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc "cat .gitignore; printf '\\n--- diff ---\\n'; git diff -- src/main.tsx src/App.tsx; printf '\\n--- new file ---\\n'; cat src/ThemeManager.tsx"
